# Night light (`display.night_light`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Display · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** yes

Turns Night light (warmer screen colors) on or off.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | one of: `on`, `off`, `toggle` | yes |  | on, off, or toggle. |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: display.night_light
    state: on
```

## In profiles

When this action is part of a [profile](../../guide/profiles.md), the current value is saved before it runs and
restored when the profile is reverted.

## Notes

This setting has no official programming interface; AutoSettings changes it the way Windows stores it internally. It works on current Windows 10 and 11 builds but may stop working after a Windows update. If it fails, the error says so; use `settings.open` to open the Settings page instead.
